articles.title: Mandaadi Nears ₹100 Crore as Day-23 Run Keeps Soori Film on Hit Track
articles.excerpt: Soori's Tamil sports drama collected 1.38 crore on its fourth Friday to reach 96.95 crore net in India, with the 100-crore mark expected over the fourth weekend.
articles.image_caption: A still from Mandaadi showing Soori in a fishing-boat sequence. The Tamil sports drama reached 96.95 crore net in India after day 23, closing in on the 100-crore mark.
articles.nri_angle: With 17.7 crore in overseas gross, the film has travelled with the Tamil diaspora in Malaysia, Singapore and the Gulf, where mid-budget sports dramas with strong word of mouth find loyal audiences.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Records 24.58 Lakh Day-One Footfalls, Bollywood's 10th-Highest Post-COVID
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's franchise finale collected 62 crore net on day one, finishing just below Tiger 3 in tickets sold while out-earning it in rupee terms.
articles.image_caption: The official poster for Drishyam: The Conclusion, featuring Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar. The franchise finale sold an estimated 24.58 lakh tickets on day one, the 10th-highest post-COVID day-one footfalls in Bollywood.
articles.nri_angle: The Drishyam brand carries a devoted diaspora following — the originals spawned multi-language remakes and strong Gulf, North American and UK audiences, where day-one shows for the finale also drew packed houses.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: New Ramayana Poster Spotlights Yash as Ravana After MrBeast's Mumbai Event
articles.excerpt: The makers released a new official poster of Yash as Ravana — in a gemstone-studded crown and royal regalia — days after a Mumbai pre-release event where MrBeast's viral 'Jai Shri Ram' moment headlined the crossover push ahead of the Diwali 2026 release.
articles.image_caption: Kannada actor Yash, who plays Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana, at a photoshoot in Mumbai.
articles.nri_angle: Worldwide IMAX release with localized versions for international markets makes this an event theatrical release for the diaspora, and the MrBeast crossover signals a deliberate play for global audiences including Indian families abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bombay High Court bars AI misuse of Samantha Ruth Prabhu's name, image, voice
articles.excerpt: Justice Madhav Jamdar granted ad-interim relief on October 1, restraining unauthorised use of the actress's identity across 18 defendants — including Meta, Google and Amazon — and ordering takedowns of AI deepfakes and morphed content.
articles.image_caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu poses for a portrait in a yellow top and turquoise earrings against a teal background. The Bombay High Court on October 1, 2026 granted her ad-interim protection against the unauthorised use of her name, image and voice.
articles.nri_angle: The takedown order covers the global platforms diaspora audiences use daily (Instagram, YouTube, Amazon), reminding overseas fans that resharing AI-generated celebrity content can draw enforcement action wherever it lands.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Reviews: Critics Call the Finale Gripping, Hail Ajay Devgn–Jaideep Ahlawat Face-Off
articles.excerpt: Critics largely praise the final chapter of the Drishyam franchise, with the Ajay Devgn–Jaideep Ahlawat showdown and the climax earning the strongest notices, even as some reviewers flag a slow first half and convenient plotting.
articles.image_caption: The official poster for Drishyam: The Conclusion features Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar alongside Tabu and Jaideep Ahlawat. Critics gave the Abhishek Pathak-directed finale an average of 3.5 stars across 18 published reviews.
articles.image_credit: Poster via Wikipedia (Panorama Studios / Star Studio18)
articles.nri_angle: For the global Indian audience, this finale arriving as an original Hindi screenplay — not another remake — marks Bollywood trusting its own writers to close one of its most beloved franchises, timed as the festive season's big family outing in cinemas worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drishyam 3: The Conclusion Opens to Rs 95.1 Crore Worldwide, Bollywood's Second-Biggest 2026 Debut
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's franchise finale collected an estimated Rs 66.75 crore net in India on day one, just shy of the Rs 100-crore debut mark but the second-highest Bollywood opening of 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The Rs 15-crore overseas day-one haul shows the Indian diaspora — in the Gulf, North America, and the UK — remains the swing audience that decides the fate of big Hindi releases.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nushrratt Bharuccha Airlifted to Mumbai After Spine Fracture in Bali Accident
articles.excerpt: The Bollywood actress suffered a spinal fracture during a work-cum-holiday trip to Bali, was flown back to Mumbai by air ambulance on October 2, and is expected to undergo spine surgery in the city.
articles.image_caption: Nushrratt Bharuccha; the actress was airlifted to Mumbai after a spine fracture in a Bali accident.
articles.nri_angle: Bharuccha's films are diaspora staples, and Bali's popularity with Indian travellers makes her air-ambulance evacuation a cautionary note on medical-repatriation travel insurance for Indians and diaspora families visiting Southeast Asia.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Closes Historic India Run With Rs. 504 Crore Haul
articles.excerpt: Tom Holland's Marvel epic wrapped its nine-week theatrical run with ₹504 crore net in India, becoming the year's second-highest-grossing release and setting a new benchmark for Hollywood films in the country.
articles.image_caption: Spider-Man: Brand New Day, starring Tom Holland, finished its Indian theatrical run at roughly Rs. 504 crore net. The nine-week run made it the second-highest-grossing release of 2026 in India.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora audiences abroad can see Bollywood's global stature rising as Hollywood's biggest franchise now treats India as a must-win market alongside the US and China.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Six Indian Films Head to Busan International Film Festival 2026
articles.excerpt: From Rima Das's Not a Hero to Anuparna Roy's Venice-bound Lovers in the Blue Night, six Indian features screen at Asia's largest film festival from October 6 — with more titles in the Vision Asia and Wide Angle sections.
articles.image_caption: Stills from Birds in the Dark (left) and Birds on Ice (right), two of the Indian films selected for the 31st Busan International Film Festival. The festival runs October 6 to 15 at the Busan Cinema Center in South Korea.
articles.nri_angle: Festival selections are the early signal of what diaspora audiences will see on streaming months later — Busan screenings with English subtitles are also gathering points for Indian cinema lovers in South Korea's South Asian expatriate community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Vvaan Crosses Rs 50 Crore in Week One Despite Drishyam 3 Arriving
articles.excerpt: Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah's fantasy thriller crossed Rs 50 crore net in India in its first week, with Rs 69.07 crore worldwide — just as Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 opened to challenge it.
articles.image_caption: Sidharth Malhotra stars in the fantasy thriller The Vvaan, which crossed Rs 50 crore net in its first week.
articles.nri_angle: The Vvaan's overseas gross of Rs 5.5 crore and its mass-circuit acceptance matter to diaspora audiences whose ticket purchases increasingly decide the fate of mid-budget Hindi originals like this Sidharth-Tamannaah fantasy thriller.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: CBFC Clears Drishyam The Conclusion With Zero Cuts; 150-Minute Runtime Confirmed
articles.excerpt: The CBFC passed the Ajay Devgn thriller with a U/A 16+ certificate on September 28 — no cuts, no modifications — setting up the 150-minute finale for its October 2 release.
articles.image_caption: Ajay Devgn returns as Vijay Salgaonkar in Drishyam The Conclusion, the final instalment of the Hindi crime-thriller franchise. The CBFC cleared the 150-minute film with a U/A 16+ certificate and zero cuts ahead of its October 2 release.
articles.nri_angle: The Drishyam franchise has a strong NRI following thanks to its Malayalam roots and family-thriller formula; The Conclusion opens overseas via Panorama Studios and Zee Studios on October 2.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 Is Now Titled 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend'
articles.excerpt: Sony Pictures announced the official title on September 28 with a new poster, confirming a worldwide IMAX 3D release on November 6, 2026, in Hindi and English under the tagline "Mankind's greatest story comes to life."
articles.image_caption: The official poster for "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend" shows Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama holding a bow opposite Yash's Ravana against a cosmic backdrop. Sony Pictures announced the title and a worldwide IMAX 3D release on November 6, 2026, under the tagline "Mankind's greatest story comes to life."
articles.nri_angle: The film is explicitly engineered for a global audience — English version, worldwide IMAX rollout, Sony's international distribution — putting diaspora audiences in Los Angeles, London, Toronto and Sydney at the center of its release plan.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drishyam 3 Sells 4.05 Lakh Tickets in Advance, 7th-Biggest Pre-Sale Ever
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam: The Conclusion has sold around 4.05 lakh opening-day tickets in PVR Inox and Cinepolis, ranking 7th all-time and second in 2026, with trade forecasting a Rs. 50 crore opening on Gandhi Jayanti.
articles.image_caption: Official poster artwork for Drishyam: The Conclusion, featuring Ajay Devgn (center) and Tabu (right). The film sold around 4.05 lakh opening-day tickets across PVR Inox and Cinepolis, the 7th-biggest advance sale in Bollywood history, ahead of its October 2 release.
articles.nri_angle: The Drishyam franchise has always traveled well with the Indian diaspora, and overseas screens in North America, the UK and the Middle East open alongside the Indian release, giving diaspora audiences a record-breaking reason to catch the finale in theaters.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: MrBeast's Ramayana Appearance Puts Spotlight on His $200,000 Event Fee
articles.excerpt: The world's most-subscribed YouTuber joined Ranbir Kapoor and the 'Ramayana: Part 1' team at a Mumbai event on September 26 — the same night a new collaboration between MrBeast and producer Namit Malhotra was revealed.
articles.image_caption: YouTuber MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) poses in a black jacket against a promotional backdrop. The world's most-subscribed YouTuber attended a September 26 "Ramayana: Part 1" event in Mumbai alongside Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and the film's team.
articles.nri_angle: The Indian epic is being marketed to a global audience — including the diaspora — and the world's biggest YouTuber chanting 'Jai Shree Ram' shows how far Indian popular culture has travelled.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rani Mukerji's Mother Krishna Mukerji Dies at 75; Bollywood Pays Last Respects
articles.excerpt: The former playback singer's last rites were held in Juhu on Tuesday evening, attended by Shah Rukh Khan, Alia Bhatt, Karan Johar and Anil Kapoor.
articles.image_caption: Actor Rani Mukerji. Her mother Krishna Mukerji, a former playback singer, died in Mumbai on September 22 at the age of 75.
articles.nri_angle: Rani Mukerji's global fanbase across the diaspora mourns with the family, whose Filmalaya roots run deep in Hindi cinema history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Two Roads to the Oscars: How Gondhal and Angh Both Entered the Race
articles.excerpt: Gondhal is India's official Oscar submission, but Angh qualified independently through a new festival-award rule — putting two Indian films on separate tracks to the 2027 Academy Awards.
articles.image_caption: A composite image pairs stills from Angh (left) and Gondhal (right) with the Academy Awards emblem. Gondhal is India's official Oscar submission while Angh qualified independently after winning the Platform Prize at the Toronto International Film Festival.
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, it's a double stake in awards season — a Marathi folk thriller carrying India's official banner and a Naga story that reached the Oscars on its own festival merit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mirzapur: The Movie Crosses Rs 315 Crore Worldwide on Day 18
articles.excerpt: The Gurmeet Singh-directed crime saga, starring Pankaj Tripathi and Ali Fazal, has become the third Hindi film of 2026 to cross Rs 300 crore at the global box office.
articles.image_caption: Promotional key art for Mirzapur: The Movie, with Pankaj Tripathi's Kaleen Bhaiya at the centre of the ensemble cast. The crime saga has crossed Rs 315 crore at the worldwide box office in 18 days, becoming the third Hindi film of 2026 to pass Rs 300 crore globally.
articles.nri_angle: The film's $5M+ overseas haul, led by North America and the Middle East, shows diaspora audiences turning streaming-era franchise loyalty into theatrical turnout.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kalki 2 Locks Pan-India Star for Cameo as Prabhas Sequel Wraps 30% of Shoot
articles.excerpt: Nag Ashwin's follow-up to the 2024 blockbuster has quietly finalized a pan-Indian actor for a special cameo, with nearly a third of filming done — while Amitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan, who never shared the screen in the first film, may finally appear together.
articles.image_caption: Prabhas as the bounty hunter Bhairava in a still from Kalki 2898 AD. The sequel, Kalki 2, has wrapped 30 percent of its shoot and locked a pan-Indian actor for a cameo, according to Pinkvilla.
articles.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora, a major driver of overseas grosses for big Telugu and pan-India blockbusters, will be tracking the sequel's casting reveals and production milestones closely as anticipation builds abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Raaka Sets Guinness World Record With 37 Simultaneous Motion-Capture Performers
articles.excerpt: Allu Arjun and Atlee's sci-fi epic was certified by Guinness World Records on September 15 for capturing 37 performers in real time — a first for a film production of this scale.
articles.image_caption: Allu Arjun and director Atlee pose with the Guinness World Records certificate on stage in Mumbai. Their film Raaka set the record for 37 performers in simultaneous motion capture.
articles.nri_angle: The Guinness record gives the diaspora a global-scale technical milestone to rally around, positioning Raaka as Indian cinema's next big-canvas spectacle with certified proof of its ambition.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Daayra’s Tepid Weekend: ₹4 Crore Haul Marks Kareena Kapoor’s Lowest in 15 Years
articles.excerpt: Meghna Gulzar's investigative thriller, starring Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran, collected an estimated ₹4.10–4.50 crore net in its first three days — with a flat Sunday showing no growth.
articles.image_caption: Promotional poster for Daayra shows Prithviraj Sukumaran as DCP Raman Kumar in a police uniform alongside Kareena Kapoor Khan as DCP Ajooni Kohli, with yellow police barricade tape in the background. The Meghna Gulzar-directed thriller collected an estimated ₹4.10–4.50 crore net in its opening weekend.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs in the US, UK and Gulf markets — where Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran both have strong followings — could still lift Daayra's fortunes, as overseas collections often cushion Hindi films with slow domestic starts.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Karan Johar to Make Film on R&AW Founder R.N. Kao, Sets August 2028 Release
articles.excerpt: The Dharma Productions feature, based on Nitin Gokhale's 'Gentleman Spymaster,' will trace Kao's journey from 1955 to the 1971 war, timed to R&AW's 60th anniversary.
articles.image_caption: Karan Johar will make a film on R&AW founder R.N. Kao, set for release in August 2028.
articles.nri_angle: R.N. Kao is a towering but little-known figure for many NRIs; the film could become the definitive mainstream introduction to the founder of India's external intelligence agency.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'Angh' Wins TIFF Platform Award, Earns Path to 2027 Oscars Race
articles.excerpt: Theja Rio's debut feature — the only Indian film in TIFF's auteur-driven Platform competition — becomes eligible for the Oscars' International Feature race under new Academy rules.
articles.image_caption: Konyak Naga community members in Nagaland. Theja Rio's film Angh is set among the Konyak people and is spoken almost entirely in the Konyak language.
articles.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora — especially North-East Indians and the large South Asian audience at TIFF — 'Angh' puts Nagaland's culture and a first-time Indian director on one of world cinema's biggest stages.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gondhal: Marathi Folk Thriller Selected as India's Oscar Entry for 2027
articles.excerpt: The Film Federation of India has chosen Santosh Davakhar's Marathi thriller Gondhal — selected from 33 submissions — as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards' Best International Feature Film category.
articles.image_caption: A folk performer in a bull mask in a scene from Gondhal. The Marathi thriller has been selected as India's official entry for the 2027 Academy Awards.
articles.nri_angle: Most Marathi Oscar entries have been nearly impossible to find with subtitles outside India — but Gondhal's seven-language dubbed versions give diaspora viewers in the US, UK and Gulf a genuine chance to watch India's official pick before the ceremony.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ajay Devgn's Two ₹50-Crore Shots: Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 Eye Historic Openings
articles.excerpt: Ajay Devgn has two 2026 releases left — Drishyam 3 on October 2 and Golmaal 5 — and both carry expectations of a historic ₹50-crore opening day, a feat only Shah Rukh Khan and Hrithik Roshan have managed twice.
articles.image_caption: Ajay Devgn. His upcoming releases Drishyam 3 and Golmaal 5 are tracking toward historic 50-crore opening days in India. (Photo: Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0)
articles.nri_angle: Opening-day records are no longer decided in India alone — diaspora audiences in the US, UK and Gulf contribute a meaningful share of Bollywood's biggest starts, and Devgn's core overseas family audience will be central to any ₹50-crore bid.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kunal Kemmu's 'Vibe' Jumps on Day 2, Beats 'Madgaon Express' Two-Day Total
articles.excerpt: The spy comedy earned an estimated ₹2.5–2.8 crore net on Saturday, pushing its two-day total past Kunal Kemmu's directorial debut and setting up a projected ₹7.5–8 crore opening weekend.
articles.image_caption: Kunal Kemmu. His film 'Vibe' jumped on day two, beating 'Madgaon Express' two-day total.
articles.nri_angle: Preity Zinta's return and a pop-culture-driven spy comedy travel well with NRI audiences; like Madgaon Express, the film's real diaspora moment may come on streaming via its Amazon MGM Studios pipeline.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mammootty's Cameo Fails to Lift 'Law & Order' Past ₹47 Lakh in Two Days
articles.excerpt: The Malayalam cop drama opened to ₹29 lakh and dropped to ₹18 lakh on day two, leaving its domestic total under ₹50 lakh despite a high-profile promotional pivot around Mammootty's special appearance.
articles.image_caption: Mammootty. His cameo in 'Law & Order' failed to lift the film past ₹47 lakh in two days.
articles.nri_angle: Malayalam diaspora audiences in the Gulf and North America skipped the film as negative word of mouth travelled fast; its only meaningful second act will be a quick streaming release for those viewers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rahul Bhatt Revisits Strained Bond With Father Mahesh Bhatt
articles.excerpt: In a new Indian Express feature, Rahul Bhatt reflects on growing up with an absent father — echoing his father Mahesh Bhatt's own account of a childhood without a father figure.
articles.image_caption: Rahul Bhatt in a photograph from around the time of his 2012 interviews. The celebrity fitness trainer has spoken repeatedly about his strained relationship with his father, filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt, a rift revisited this week by The Indian Express.
articles.nri_angle: The Bhatts' story is Bollywood-specific but the themes — absent fathers, divorce, and whether a parent owes money, presence or both — play out in Indian families everywhere, including across the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ayesha Kapur Returns to Bollywood 17 Years After 'Black'
articles.excerpt: The actor, who won a Filmfare Award at 11 for playing young Michelle in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's 'Black,' returns to the big screen in 'Om Ka Hari' — telling Hindustan Times the post-'Black' chatter once derailed her decision-making.
articles.image_caption: Ayesha Kapur with husband Adam Oberoi at their March 2025 wedding in Delhi, in a photo montage that includes a still of her as young Michelle in Black. Kapur has returned to Hindi cinema after a 17-year gap with the family drama Om Ka Hari.
articles.nri_angle: Born in Germany, raised in Auroville, educated in New York and now acting in Mumbai, Kapur's cross-continental life mirrors the diaspora experience — and her candid account of child stardom and adult interference resonates with parents navigating a talented child's ambitions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Welcome Their Second Daughter
articles.excerpt: The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, in a joint social media post signed "Dua, Deepika & Ranveer" — crediting their first daughter, Dua, born in September 2024, with welcoming her baby sister.
articles.image_caption: Ranveer Singh and a pregnant Deepika Padukone pose together in a black-and-white maternity photoshoot. The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, 2026, in a joint social media post signed Dua, Deepika and Ranveer.
articles.nri_angle: The couple counts among the most-followed Indian cultural figures globally, and their family milestones travel instantly through diaspora networks — resonating with parents abroad balancing careers and young families.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mindy Kaling Calls Maitreyi Ramakrishnan 'Sparkly' as Netflix's Best of the Best Drops
articles.excerpt: Kaling posted an emotional Instagram tribute to Ramakrishnan — the actress she cast in Never Have I Ever — as the Bollywood-fusion dance film hit Netflix.
articles.image_caption: Maitreyi Ramakrishnan. Mindy Kaling called the Never Have I Ever star 'sparkly' on Instagram as Netflix released Best of the Best on September 18, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: The film's journey from campus dance circuits to a global Netflix release marks how the South Asian American dance scene has become mainstream cultural capital.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bhumi Pednekar Walks for Nazranaa at New York Fashion Week in Maroon Lehenga
articles.excerpt: The Bollywood actor made her runway debut at NYFW as the showstopper for Nazranaa's Samskriti 2.0 collection, a line inspired by Indian temple architecture and craft traditions.
articles.image_caption: Bhumi Pednekar walks the runway in a maroon velvet lehenga. She closed the show as the showstopper for Nazranaa's Samskriti 2.0 collection at New York Fashion Week.
articles.nri_angle: A New Jersey Indian-American bridal house closing NYFW with a Bollywood star shows how diaspora fashion businesses are carrying Indian craft onto the global runway in their own right.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
